assessment: Immunometabolism is an emerging field, and to understand immune cell metabolism during inflammation and infection is of great interest. In this report, cutting edge microscopy techniques and innovative zebrafish models are used to characterize the metabolism of macrophages in situ. In the future, fluorescence microscopy approaches pioneered using zebrafish may illuminate strategies to therapeutically manipulate metabolism in human immune cells.
